items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: He used to be my neighbor on Monroe Street.

ctx.x: I'm so glad I got my religion in time. I'm so glad I got my religion in time. Oh my Lord, oh my Lord, what shall I do?

I want to get that bottle down again. I didn't quite understand that. This was a neighbor next door? Uh-huh. A neighbor next door. And he would take a, oh that was Celestan that had the bottle. He said we're playing the bottle. But this boy played in a can. He'd take a can and put it to his mouth. And he would just hum and hit on it with his hands, his fingers. And make the most prettiest. And I mean it sound like real. It just was so plain you could understand. He's here in the city now? I don't know where they…
We'd be like, you know what to sing on that comb. Good. Yeah.
